BiblicalUsage: The word is freshly plucked, just torn off. The dove came back to Noah in the evening, and lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf plucked off, the first sign that the waters were abated from off the earth.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that one fresh leaf was enough for Noah: the flood was going down, and life was coming back.
